referenceBandGeometry.derivation: rho/d0=1/(P*sigma), V*d0/D=2*sigma*P^2; Vmin=(1-r)^3 Vref, rhomax=rhoref/(1-r)^2. The inherited v3 horizon/cadence are now frozen constants, not recomputed from reference values or observations. Actual terminal-window clearance remains mandatory.

terminalObservation.timeUnit: base-arm tau0; arm solver time is physical time times (lambda_base/lambda_arm)^3
terminalObservation.schedule: cadence anchored at the fixed terminal time; every requested checkpoint is rounded upward with ceil(requested solver time/dt), independently, to an integer substep
terminalObservation.selection: only the final ten declared checkpoints are evaluated; missing, unresolved, duplicated, mis-timed, or unfinished endpoints are refused; earlier qualifying/reference-matching windows cannot substitute
terminalObservation.firstQualification: diagnostic only; it never changes a checkpoint, terminal time, or acceptance window
terminalObservation.clock: exact integer substep identity; reported FP64 clock may differ only by its sequential arithmetic accumulation bound; fits use steps*dt
terminalObservation.caveat: a fixed endpoint prevents outcome-selected observation timing; it does not establish asymptotic convergence or repair failed stationarity, boundary, metrology, or reference checks

contract.metrology: quintic roots in the monotone atanh(1-2psi) ordinate checked against cubic roots in the same ordinate; raw-phase quintic sensitivity reported separately; even quadratic and quartic local surfaces over .25-.5 rho, extrapolated against window^4
contract.stationarity: last three four-sample windows overlap within independently estimated geometry/linear-fit uncertainty; retained-sample rho variation and variation/trend among the three fitted four-sample velocities each <=one quarter of the reference target, independently of geometric uncertainty; propagated P and sigma uncertainty below the target; this does not bound every adjacent-interval or sub-cadence velocity
contract.note: Raw cubic epsilon4 is refined with dx; no unpublished grid-anisotropy correction is inserted to match the paper.
contract.widthMatching: W0 scales with lambda; tau0 scales with lambda^3. Extents and initial radius/d0 match; compare P, sigma, rho/d0 and Vd0/D, never unscaled solver rho or velocity across lambda.
contract.boundaryAssessment: D/V is a startup diagnostic, not an early contamination verdict. Final clearance must exceed eight conservative D/V lengths at every sample of the retained stationary window; conservative speed is min(V-error) over its fitted windows and geometry uses upper uncertainty bounds.
contract.controlComparison: pointwise P, sigma, rho/d0 and Vd0/D changes retain the original reference-target band; control convergence is reported separately and cannot establish overall literature acceptance
